description: Bloomberg terminal Trading Floor panel upgraded from v4 (5 agents, stale fields) to v5 (217-agent fleet). Updated TRADING_FLOOR_FILE constant to read trading-floor-v5-latest.json. Rewrote build_trading_floor_panel() to use v5 schema fields (bankroll, roi, win_rate, total_bets/wins, active, tier). Panel now shows top 15 of 217 agents with Tier column (META/PREM/FREE+/SPEC), ROI%, W%, W/L. Subtitle shows agent count breakdown by tier (T1/T2/T3/T4).
